Complete Property Management

One agreed plan that covers inspections, tenant and rent coordination, maintenance and owner reporting for a property in Chennai.

Discuss Your Property WhatsApp Us

The problem this solves

Owning property from a distance usually means juggling a watchman, a relative, a plumber's number and an association WhatsApp group. Each one knows a piece of the picture. Nobody owns the whole of it, and small issues become expensive ones because no one was looking.

What the service includes

  • A written management plan setting out scope, inspection frequency, approval limits and reporting schedule
  • Scheduled property inspections with dated photographs and condition notes
  • Tenant and rent coordination if the property is let, including renewals and move-outs
  • Maintenance coordination: quotations, your approval, vendor supervision, completion check
  • Liaison with the apartment association or society on routine matters
  • Owner updates and periodic summary reports on the agreed channel
  • A single point of contact for the property

How it works

Onboarding visit

We inspect the property, photograph its current condition, note meter readings, keys and access arrangements, and record existing issues.

Plan in writing

You receive the proposed scope, fee, approval process and reporting frequency. Nothing starts until you confirm.

Routine care

Inspections, tenant communication and maintenance follow the plan. Anything outside it is raised with you first.

Reporting

Each inspection and each piece of work produces an update. A periodic summary ties the month or quarter together.

What you receive

  • Onboarding condition report
  • Inspection reports on the agreed schedule
  • Quotations and approval requests before non-emergency work
  • Completion photographs and final costs for each job
  • Periodic summary of activity, costs and open items

Limits and exclusions

  • Legal representation, tax advice, property valuation and structural certification are not included; we can suggest independent professionals.
  • Major renovation projects are quoted separately under Interior Improvements & Refurbishment.
  • Vendor charges are paid by the owner and are separate from the management fee.
  • Emergency response arrangements and spending limits are defined in the plan, not assumed.

Questions about this service

Do I need to be in Chennai for onboarding?

No. Access can be arranged through a key handover with a person you nominate, or with the current tenant. The onboarding report shows you what we found.

Can I start with a smaller scope and expand later?

Yes. Many owners begin with inspections and maintenance coordination and add tenant management later. The plan is amended in writing when the scope changes.

Who holds the keys?

That is agreed at onboarding. Options include keys held by us under a signed record, a keybox at the property, or keys with a person you nominate.

No questions match that. Ask us directly on WhatsApp or through the contact page.

Ask about complete property management

Tell us where the property is and what is happening with it now. We will reply with questions and, if it fits, a written proposal.
